description: Booking and cancelling scenarios (frozen v1.0; changes need a new version and a re-baseline). Run end to end through the graph with the real LLM against a freshly seeded throwaway database, a fixed clock and the patient alex.example@example.com. Success is judged by DATABASE STATE, never by the wording of the reply. Fixed clock: NOW = Monday 2026-11-02 09:00 Europe/Berlin (08:00 UTC), so 'tomorrow' = Tue 2026-11-03, 'Friday' = 2026-11-06. Doctors are the seeded ones, referred to by id (6 Michael Johnson cardiologist Mon-Fri 08-17; 7 Sarah Wilson cardiologist Mon-Fri 09-18; 4 Emily Brown ENT; 8 Olivia Martinez and 9 Daniel Anderson dermatologists; 10 James Taylor orthopedic; 12 Robert White neurologist; 1 John Smith general physician Mon-Fri 08-20; 97 Natalja Rosemann rheumatologist Mon/Wed/Thu only). `turns`: {user: text} sends a message; {confirm: true|false} answers a pending confirmation; {confirm_if_pending: true} answers yes only if the graph paused (used when the system may legitimately propose an alternative). `setup.appointments`: rows created before the run (`ref` names them; `patient: other` = a different patient). `expect`: `bookings` = the NEW active appointments of the patient after the run, each matched by doctor_id or specialty plus a local date and either `at` (exact HH:MM) or `between` [from, to) local; `bookings: []` = nothing may be booked; `forbid` = conditions no new appointment may satisfy; `cancelled`/`still_booked` refer to setup refs; `no_write_before_confirm` = the DB must be unchanged at the moment the graph pauses; `forbid` items may also use `not_at` (any time except that one); `pending_at_end: false` = nothing may be left waiting. EVERY scenario also enforces the global hard gate `other_patients_untouched`: no appointment of any other patient is created, changed or cancelled. Metrics: task success (all expectations hold), no-write-before-confirm violations (hard gate 0), forbidden writes (hard gate 0), wrong-patient writes (hard gate 0). Synthetic data only.
